subject: SIG/CAIQ: Encryption & KMS evidence request — AetherBank onboarding
messages:
From: Claire Reynolds <claire.reynolds@aetherbank.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:18:00Z
Subject: SIG/CAIQ encryption section — initial evidence ask

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. As part of AetherBank's SIG/CAIQ evaluation we need to collect the encryption and key management artifacts for your hosted offering. Below is a prioritized list of items our InfoSec reviewer is asking for:

- KMS architecture diagram (how keys are generated, wrapped/unwrapped, where they live)
- HSM attestation or vendor certificate (FIPS 140-2/3 or vendor report)
- Key rotation policy and an example rotation run (dates, actor, verification steps)
- Operator access matrix for HSM/KMS (who can perform generation, wrap/unwrap, emergency key export)
- Sample rotation logs for the last 90 days (redacted IDs are fine)
- Evidence of at-rest encryption for customer blobs (S3/KV) and the KMS bindings
- TLS configuration summary for in-transit protection (cipher suites, cert rotation cadence)

Can you confirm whether you can provide these as artifacts or point to a canonical page? We'd like to bundle the items into our SOC/SIG packet by 2026-12-10.

Appreciate it — if easier, we can carve this into a mutual action plan and assign clear deliverables.

Best,
Claire
Claire Reynolds
Sr. Information Security Manager, AetherBank
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Reynolds <claire.reynolds@aetherbank.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T12:05:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ encryption section — initial evidence ask

Hi Claire —

Thanks, and welcome — we can provide the artifacts you listed. High-level plan:

1) Attach a short CAIQ/SIG-focused summary (PDF) that maps your checklist items to our artifacts.
2) Deliver concrete artifacts: HSM attestation, operator access matrix, rotation log excerpt, network diagram.
3) Provide a short statement of in-transit and at-rest encryption controls and the TLS cipher suite baseline.

I've looped in Irene (Security) and Marissa (Crypto Ops). Proposed timeline: internal owners deliver drafts by 2026-12-03; I will package and send the full bundle by 2026-12-07 so you have a few days to review ahead of your 12/10 target.

Attachments included for visibility: redwood-caiq-encryption-summary.pdf; kms-rotation-sample-2026.csv (redacted).

Quick clarifying Qs — can you confirm whether you need the HSM vendor attestation to show module-level FIPS validation or a hardware vendor statement will suffice? Also, do you need raw rotation logs or a summarized CSV extract with operator IDs redacted?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of GTM Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachments:
- redwood-caiq-encryption-summary.pdf (summary mapping)
- kms-rotation-sample-2026.csv (rotation run excerpt, operator IDs redacted)
From: Claire Reynolds <claire.reynolds@aetherbank.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-02T08:41:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ encryption section — initial evidence ask

Vanessa —

Thanks for the quick reply and for the drafts. Couple of clarifications from our side:

- We require either a FIPS module certificate for the HSMs or a vendor attestation that explicitly references FIPS 140-2/3 compliance. A vendor statement alone without module validation will be an exception
- For rotation logs, a summarized CSV extract is preferred. Please include date/time (UTC), rotation actor role (e.g., crypto-ops), and verification status. You can redact user ids but keep unique operator tokens (e.g., OP-123) so we can validate separation of duties
- Please include a brief paragraph describing how BYOK tenants (if any) are isolated from Redwood's operational keys

We're attaching our SIG extraction template (aetherbank-sig-template.xlsx) to make mapping easier. If you can get us the HSM attestation and summarized rotation extract by 12/07 that would be ideal.

Regards,
Claire
--
Claire Reynolds
Sr. Information Security Manager, AetherBank
Attachment: aetherbank-sig-template.xlsx
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-03T10:22:00Z
Subject: Internal: AetherBank artifact ownership and cadence

Vanessa/Marissa —

Notes after intake:
- Marissa: own HSM attestation collection and rotation-log extract (we will request vendor FIPS cert from our HSM provider and generate a redacted CSV for Aether). Estimated delivery: 2026-12-06 EOD.
- Irene: compile operator access matrix (who has which roles on the key lifecycle; include separation-of-duties note). Delivery: 2026-12-05.
- Vanessa: packaging + CAIQ mapping + TLS statement and BYOK isolation paragraph. Will assemble final bundle and send to Claire on 2026-12-07.

Internal points: ensure rotation logs include the nonce/hash verification column and the ticket/PR reference for each rotation event. Keep copies in secure Jira SEC-482. We will redact human-identifying fields but preserve stable operator tokens as requested.

I'll coordinate with Ops to pull the rotation samples tonight.

Irene Choi
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Reynolds <claire.reynolds@aetherbank.com>, Tommy Lee <tommy.lee@aetherbank.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-07T16:30:00Z
Subject: Delivery: Encryption & KMS evidence bundle for SIG/CAIQ (AetherBank)

Hi Claire / Tommy —

Per our plan, attached is the bundle for the SIG/CAIQ encryption section. Items included:

- hsm-attestation-2026.pdf (vendor FIPS module cert + attestation statement)
- kms-rotation-sample-2026.csv (summarized extract; columns: utc_time, operator_token, rotation_step, verification_status, ticket_ref, sha256_hash)
- operator-access-matrix.xlsx (roles: generate, wrap, rotate, emergency-export; mapped to internal teams and job titles)
- network-diagram.png (high-level KMS placement and customer isolation boundaries)
- redwood-caiq-encryption-summary.pdf (CAIQ mapping, BYOK isolation paragraph, TLS baseline)

Highlights / notes:
- HSM attestation references the vendor FIPS 140-2 certificate number and module validation date. We do not provide private HSM keys; vendor attestation confirms module-level validation.
- The rotation CSV has operator tokens (OP-xxx) — these are stable identifiers used to prove separation of duties; human ids are redacted per our privacy practice.
- BYOK tenants: BYOK keys are customer-managed and wrapped under tenant-specific KEKs. Operational keys are separated from tenant KEKs and are subject to strict role-based access; see BYOK isolation paragraph in the summary PDF.
- TLS: current baseline is TLS1.2+ with preference for TLS1.3; cipher suite list and cert rotation cadence are in the summary PDF.

Related links: Jira SEC-482 (contains the internal rotation tickets), HubSpot 48021.

Next steps — please confirm receipt and let us know if you want an artifact-level walkthrough (we can schedule a 30-minute call next week). If you need additional evidence (e.g., raw HSM audit logs under an NDA), we can discuss scope and redaction requirements.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of GTM Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachments:
- hsm-attestation-2026.pdf
- kms-rotation-sample-2026.csv
- operator-access-matrix.xlsx
- network-diagram.png
- redwood-caiq-encryption-summary.pdf
